take_text: Low blocks kill the sport. If you park the bus for 90 minutes against a top team, you're not 'defending well' — you're admitting football is boring and you'd rather not play it. Change my mind.
Messi > Pelé *only* because of longevity, not peak. Pelé's 1958-1963 peak was higher than anything Messi did. Messi's GOAT case is 15+ years at world-class level, not a single season.
